column1: # Horizontal-tail small UAV with turbojet engine
# Concept: wing + conventional horizontal tail; no X-tail or H-tail modeling.
# A small single vertical stabilizer is retained for the standard FLOPS geometry path.
# This is a lightweight conceptual Aviary/FLOPS sandbox
# num_tails=1 keeps the FLOPS/Dymos ODE VTP drag slots alive (avoids
# characteristic_length parameter error). mass_scaler=0 and wetted_area=0
# zero out the FLOPS mass and drag contributions.
# area and aspect_ratio here are FLOPS-only placeholders; the design-variable
# driven geometry comes from HTailGeometry (outputs vtp_area / vtp_ar).
# Computed from wing span and area by FLOPS geometry.
# Computed by FLOPS geometry so wing geometry design variables can affect parasite drag.
